title: OpenRouter is joining Stripe
summary: Stripe is acquiring OpenRouter, an AI model aggregation platform that provides unified API access to multiple AI providers, in a deal reportedly worth over $7 billion. This acquisition represents Stripe's strategic expansion into AI infrastructure services and highlights the growing consolidation in the AI developer tools space.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of fragmented AI APIs by providing developers with a single unified interface to access and route requests across multiple AI model providers.
why_valuable: The acquisition validates OpenRouter's business model of simplifying AI model access and positions Stripe to integrate AI capabilities into its payment and developer infrastructure ecosystem.
